type InOrderOptions = {reason: string};
async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: InOrderOptions) {
 for (const item of items) { await step(item); }
}
async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: InOrderOptions) {
 for (const step of steps) { await step(); }
}
async function use() {
 await inOrder([], async item => {}, {reason: 'Each update reads the previous write'});
 await inOrderSteps([], {reason: 'Each stage reads the previous stage output'});
}
